alignments.note: Verbless Greek clause with an adjectival predicate; the supplied copula is a rule 53 helper on the predicate adjective, not on the subject noun phrase.
Anarthrous indefinite; the supplied determiner is a rule 7/51 helper. Head on the nominal *man* rather than the determiner.

One Greek noun rendered by the whole phrase *the office of a bishop*. Rule 91's test puts the head on *office*: the corpus spends *bishop* on ἐπίσκοπος (1TI.3.2), so *office* is what answers to the abstract lexeme ἐπισκοπή. A head on *bishop* is the competing reading.
Adjective and noun both anarthrous, so the supplied determiner belongs to the noun under rule 58; discontinuous under rule 15.
Inflected verb takes its English subject; head on the lexical verb under rule 9.
